title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-05
source: Stereo SBD MR>R>DAT(3)>CDR(unknown number of CD gens)>EAC> Cool Edit 2000>CD Wave>SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑'67 show highlighted by a fiery first Turn On Your Love Light and scorching Alligator.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean sound‑board source that fans describe as clear and well‑balanced (with a suggested EQ boost). Musically the night shines with the debut “Turn On Your Love Light” and a hot, tight rendition of “Alligator”, making it one of the standout early Dead performances. Overall the energy is high and the set flows smoothly from early material into the new Lovelight showcase.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality indicate a top‑tier show with an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix; reviewers note no major flaws but recommend using EQ for optimal playback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑era set that builds excitement, featuring the first-ever “Turn On Your Love Light” as a high‑energy climax and tight Alligator performance; fans note it caps an 8‑show run nicely.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ work and vocal energy are highlighted, especially on “Turn On Your Love Light” and the fiery “Alligator”.
